Why_this_title: First third-party IP after ~4 years live service and 300M cumulative downloads; publisher frames it as retention/lifecycle extension.
What_to_learn: Use IP after base loop and LiveOps engine prove scale; give collaboration a returning-user job.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not use costly IP to compensate for unproven core.

Why_this_title: Standalone island keeps hotel service/upgrade gameplay.
What_to_learn: Change art/character/story/reward identity while keeping proven session grammar.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not replace core with unrelated event minigame.

Why_this_title: Event-earned skins remain usable in main game.
What_to_learn: Temporary event effort should leave permanent account value.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not make all IP progress disappear at expiry.

Why_this_title: Apr23 2026 to Mar31 2027 (~343d), while non-IP LiveOps continue.
What_to_learn: Amortize licensed art/approval over long-running destination.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not freeze normal content cadence around one partnership.

Why_this_title: >700K completions by day 54 and publisher says prior users returned.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not turn completion count into incremental retention/revenue without denominator/control.
